faqs.q: Who can partner with MySkills?
faqs.a: Mentors who want to guide students, counsellors and career guides who support them, training institutes that teach digital marketing or related career skills, and companies that can offer internships.

faqs.q: Does it cost anything to apply?
faqs.a: No. Creating a partner account is free, and there is nothing to pay at any step. We review every request by hand and reply by email.

faqs.q: Who are the students?
faqs.a: Students and early-career learners across India working through the MySkills Digital Marketing Programme and Career Readiness Programme.

faqs.q: What happens after I create a partner account?
faqs.a: You confirm your email with a 6-digit code, then the MySkills team verifies your request. Until they approve it you can't see any student and no student sees you. Once approved, the Community portal opens with only what your role needs.

faqs.q: I already filled in an application form. Do I still need an account?
faqs.a: Yes. The application tells us about you; the account is how you sign in. Use the same email address and the team will match them, so verification is quicker.

mentors.seoTitle: Become an Online Mentor for Students in India | MySkills
mentors.seoDescription: Mentor students in digital marketing and career skills. See their aptitude report, run sessions your own way and award skill badges. Create your mentor account in minutes; the team verifies every mentor.
mentors.h1: Become a mentor and help students build real skills
mentors.intro: MySkills students practise digital marketing and career-readiness skills with AI, then work with a real mentor who knows the field. If you've done the work, a little of your time changes how a student starts their career.
mentors.benefitsTitle: What mentoring on MySkills looks like

benefits.title: Students arrive prepared
benefits.body: A student asks you after taking an aptitude assessment, so you see their strengths, gaps and what they want help with before you say yes.

benefits.title: Mentor your way
benefits.body: You accept or decline each request. You arrange sessions with the student by call, video or chat, and you can pause new requests whenever you're busy.

benefits.title: Your word carries weight
benefits.body: Award a skill badge when a student has earned it in practice, and record projects you've seen them complete. Both appear on their profile with your name.

benefits.title: A profile and a portal of your own
benefits.body: A MySkills mentor profile with your photo, expertise and LinkedIn link, and a private portal to manage requests, students and sessions.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.body: Sign up as a mentor and tell us a little about your experience. It takes a few minutes.

steps.title: Confirm your email
steps.body: Enter the 6-digit code we send to the address you signed up with.

steps.title: The team verifies you
steps.body: A real person checks every mentor before they are one, and emails you the outcome.

steps.title: Set up your profile
steps.body: Sign in to the Community portal and finish your profile. Students can find you once it is complete.

steps.title: Meet your students
steps.body: Accept requests, hold sessions your way and log each one.

lookingFor: Real experience in digital marketing, or in skills like communication, leadership and goal setting
Patience and clarity with people who are just starting out
Time to hold sessions — you decide how many students you take
A LinkedIn profile and a phone number we can reach you on

faqs.q: How do I become a mentor?
faqs.a: Create a mentor account, confirm your email with the code we send, and the MySkills team verifies you. There is no separate application form: nobody is listed as a mentor until their email is confirmed and the team has verified them.

faqs.q: Who are the students?
faqs.a: Students and early-career learners across India working through the Digital Marketing Programme (eight skill tracks) and the Career Readiness Programme (five modules). They practise with AI first, then ask a mentor to work with them.

faqs.q: How much time will mentoring take?
faqs.a: That's up to you. You accept or decline each request, agree session times with the student, and can pause new requests at any time. Students you're already working with aren't affected when you pause.

faqs.q: What happens in a session?
faqs.a: Whatever helps the student most — reviewing their practice work, answering questions or coaching them toward their goals. You arrange the sessions yourselves and log each one in the Community portal.

faqs.q: What do students see about me?
faqs.a: Your name, photo, title, bio, areas of expertise and LinkedIn link. Your phone number and email stay private and are used only by the MySkills team to reach you.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: The team verifies every mentor by hand and emails you. Once verified, your Community portal opens and you finish your profile there. Students see you when it is complete.

institutions.seoTitle: Partner Your Training Institute with MySkills | Get Listed
institutions.seoDescription: Run digital marketing or career-skills courses? Become a verified MySkills partner institute and get listed for students looking for classroom learning. Apply in minutes.
institutions.intro: MySkills students learn online first, and many want a classroom, a teacher in the room and an institute they can visit. Partner institutions are verified and listed in the MySkills Community, so those students can find you.

benefits.title: A verified listing
benefits.body: Your institution, courses, city, website and Google rating, shown to MySkills students under a verified partner listing.

benefits.title: Enquiries from interested students
benefits.body: Students who want classroom learning can send an enquiry through MySkills, so the conversation starts with someone who has already chosen to learn.

benefits.title: Students with a head start
benefits.body: MySkills students arrive having practised real scenarios and taken an aptitude assessment, so they know what they want to study.

benefits.title: Ratings that build trust
benefits.body: Students can rate partner institutions, giving future students an honest view alongside your Google rating.

steps.title: Apply
steps.body: Tell us about your institution and the courses you run, then create your partner account. It takes a few minutes.

steps.title: We verify
steps.body: We check your details — legal name, years in education, website and Google profile — before anything goes live.

steps.title: Get listed
steps.body: Your partner listing appears in the MySkills Community for signed-in students.

steps.title: Hear from students
steps.body: Interested students send enquiries through MySkills.

lookingFor: An established institution or training centre teaching digital marketing or related career skills
A verifiable presence online — a website and, ideally, a Google business profile
Courses students can actually attend, in a named city
A contact person we can reach by email and phone

faqs.q: Which institutions can apply?
faqs.a: Training institutes, colleges and academies that run digital marketing courses or other career-skills programmes and can be verified online.

faqs.q: How do you verify an institution?
faqs.a: We review the details you give us — your institution's legal name, how long it has been teaching, and its website and Google profile — before listing it.

faqs.q: How do students find us?
faqs.a: Verified partners are listed in the MySkills Community, where signed-in students can see your courses and city, rate your institution and send an enquiry.

faqs.q: What do you need from us to apply?
faqs.a: Your institution's name and city, the courses you offer, how many years you have been teaching, your website and Google profile, and a contact person.

faqs.q: What happens after we apply?
faqs.a: We review every application by hand and email the contact you name. If it's a fit, we verify the details and publish your listing.

companies.h1: Offer internships to students who've shown their skills
companies.intro: Hire interns who've practised real scenarios, worked with mentors and built a Career Readiness Score — not just sent a résumé. Tell us about your company and the roles you're offering, and we'll be in touch.

benefits.title: Evidence, not just a CV
benefits.body: Every student builds a Career Readiness Score out of 100 from what they do on MySkills: learning, practice, live mentor sessions and mentor sign-off.

benefits.title: Skills a mentor has vouched for
benefits.body: Skill badges and projects on a student's profile are awarded and verified by the mentors who worked with them.

benefits.title: Students across India
benefits.body: A growing pool of students working through the Digital Marketing and Career Readiness programmes.

benefits.title: You describe the role
benefits.body: Tell us what kind of internships you can offer and the skills you need, and we'll talk it through with you.

steps.title: Tell us about your company
steps.body: Your company, the kinds of internships you can offer and who to contact. Then create your partner account.

steps.title: We get in touch
steps.body: A real person reads every submission and reaches out to understand the roles.

steps.title: Meet students who've shown their skills
steps.body: Interns come from students with a track record on MySkills, not a blank page.

lookingFor: A company or agency with real, supervised work for interns to do
Clear roles — for example marketing, content, analytics or design
A named contact we can reach by email and phone

faqs.q: What is the Career Readiness Score?
faqs.a: A score out of 100 that counts only what a student does on MySkills: learning and practice across their programmes, live sessions with mentors, and mentor sign-off. It is worked out on our servers, not typed in by the student.

faqs.q: What kinds of internships can we offer?
faqs.a: Roles where MySkills students' skills apply. Digital marketing is the largest programme today — SEO, paid ads, analytics and content — with personal and career skills alongside.

faqs.q: How do students become available?
faqs.a: Students build their profile through the programmes: practice, mentor sessions, skill badges and projects. We'll talk with you about the roles and the profile you're looking for.

faqs.q: Do we need a MySkills account?
faqs.a: Not to tell us about your company. Once the form is in, you create a partner account with the same email address; the team verifies it, and that is how you sign in to the Community portal.

faqs.q: What happens after we submit?
faqs.a: A real person at MySkills reads it and contacts the person you name to discuss your roles.
